intro: Blackrock Stronghold is a heavily fortified encampment carved into the crags of the northern Burning Steppes, positioned right outside the entrance to Blackrock Mountain. It serves as a major field garrison for the Blackrock orcs and their allies under the Dark Horde banner.

p: Sprawling across the scorched foothills below Blackrock Mountain, the stronghold functions as the primary ground base for the Blackrock clan in the Burning Steppes. Unlike Thrall's Horde, these orcs cling to their warlike legacy, serving Rend Blackhand and the dragonkin who lurk above in the spire.

The stronghold serves as both an outer defense and a staging ground for attacks into the Redridge Mountains and neighboring human lands. The fortress maintains a constant watch over the southern approaches to the mountain, challenging anyone who dares traverse the blasted wastes.
